method: Continuous agent-directed browser walk through public WebMCP actions, using the same movement and interaction controller as the visible controls; screenshots reviewed at room stops.
observed_obstacles: Closed D3 door and sofa blocked attempted motion. The visitor retreated and used the actual door/clear route without resetting. Door safety required stepping back before opening from contact.
visual_defect_found: Art_D2_Frame covered part of a window. Moved to the right solid wall in Blender and added a nine-point solid-backing regression check. Geometry/interchange/physics checks repeated on the corrected revision.
hardware: Ryzen 7 8845HS, 15.31 GB physical RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4070 Laptop GPU, ANGLE D3D11, Codex embedded Chromium on Windows
performance_scope: Last 12000 active frames include inspection pauses between movement commands; not the final continuous 60-second benchmark.
memory_scope: Browser-reported JavaScript heap; excludes GPU memory and can be rounded. Geometry/texture values are counts, not bytes.
